newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips open mixed, Nasdaq higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips open mixed, Nasdaq higher.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks were mixed at the open on Wednesday, while the technology-dominated Nasdaq rose after Tuesday's dramatic rebound.
Dealers said softer-than-expected durable goods data for May was seen confirming the view that the Federal Reserve would not hike interest rates at its meeting next week.
The Dow Industrials was off 3.16 points at the start at 7,754.90. The Nasdaq Composite rose 1.32 to 1,453.75, while the S&P Index fell 0.40 points to 895.94.
The 30-year long bond was off 8/32 to yield 6.71 percent .
